prompts.back:

Reference1 hero_B1.png is AUTHORITATIVE for design, palette, proportions, long coat hem length and ORIGINAL book mark. Mature low saturation dark pixel art, lean adult7-head anatomy, weary35-ish man, short swept-back untidy brown hair, no hat, no hood over head, no armor. Pale bone shirt and dark soft neckcloth tucked inside collar, old small brass railway badge on character's LEFT chest. GENUINE transparent background, NO floor, NO contact or cast shadow, NO glow, NO aura, NO labels, NO text. Both boots seen from behind with subtle top surfaces. FRONT WAIST BOOK IS HIDDEN, do NOT put any book, cyan sigil or emblem on back. Do not turn coat into cape or apron.
